summary.content:
Today's selection covers 92 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI made economic proposals — here’s what DC thinks of them
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Fraud Rockets Higher in Mobile-First Latin America
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 40 articles published in the last 24 hours
